title: Midnight Vault
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium original slot-game catalogue title card, landscape 2:1, intended export 768x384 pixels.
Primary request: create finished MIDNIGHT VAULT artwork for an original Art Deco jewel-heist game.
Scene/backdrop: midnight navy vault interior, quiet smoky blue-black edges and restrained champagne-brass Art Deco architecture.
Subject: an original compact circular navy-and-brass mechanical vault medallion with a ruby center behind the title, plus one faceted ruby jewel and a small clear diamond as restrained accents. No people.
Style/medium: polished premium 3D slot illustration with clean broad highlights and bold readable forms. Lustrous champagne brass, deep navy enamel, cool steel shadow, rich ruby-red faceting, tiny icy diamond accents. Warm highlights from upper left, carefully controlled gloss, consistent with luxurious Art Deco jewelry.
Composition/framing: wide 2:1 composition. Enormous two-line title centered, MIDNIGHT above VAULT. Title, medallion and jewels must fit entirely in x=16%-84%, y=18%-82%. All outer margins quiet dark navy. No cropping of letters. Title strongly readable at 256x128 thumbnail.
Text (verbatim): "MIDNIGHT VAULT" exactly once, two lines. MIDNIGHT on top; VAULT below. Bold geometric Art Deco display lettering with pale champagne-gold front faces, restrained brass bevel and dark navy extrusion. Spell M I D N I G H T and V A U L T exactly.
Constraints: one original finished illustration. No other text, slogans, UI, reels, payout claims, numbers, brand logos, franchise imagery, characters, guns or watermarks. Keep all materials coherent, no glitter clutter. Output at moderate raster master size around1536x768, not4K.
visualCheck: Actual final768x384 export and gameplay-size previews inspected; exact MIDNIGHT VAULT text.
Responsive384/768/1024 title variants wired locally; no deployment.

generationHistory.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original premium slot-game catalogue title card, one wide 2:1 landscape illustration.
Primary request: professionally illustrated key art for Dragon Hoard using its existing crimson fire dragon, ember-lit mountain keep, enchanted treasure chest and royal gemstone identity.
Scene/backdrop: deep blood-red and charcoal volcanic mountain keep at dusk, distant castle towers with restrained ember windows, soft smoky clouds and a few subdued embers. Broad dark quiet outer margins.
Subject: a compact original Western fantasy red dragon head-and-upper-neck vignette with two horns and folded batlike wings, richly sculpted crimson scales, amber eyes and a subtle warm ember glow in its throat. Below it, one small ornate red-and-gold treasure chest containing a royal ruby, blue jewel and a restrained scattering of illustrated gold treasure coins. Dragon looks alert and protective rather than violent; claw rests naturally on the chest edge. Keep anatomy convincing, one coherent dragon and two folded wings. Fresh original designs.
Style/medium: premium professionally illustrated fantasy 3D key art, detailed scales, antique royal gold, faceted gemstones, controlled warm lighting and atmospheric depth, polished cohesive collection finish. Not a screenshot, existing franchise creature or photorealistic money pile.
Composition/framing: wide 2:1. Very LARGE two-line title balances the compact dragon-and-chest vignette. The full title and all main horn tips, wing edges, dragon neck and chest must fit ENTIRELY inside the middle rectangle x=22%-78%, y=24%-76%. Intentionally leave generous quiet background on ALL four sides. Title unmistakable and readable at 256x128 thumbnail, no title letters hidden by props.
Color palette: blood-dark #2f0a0a, crimson #9b2b1e, deep #300d09, amber #e99b31, gold #f2ce67, restrained ember glow #ff6b32, warm ivory/gold title faces.
Lighting/mood: warm ember rim light and soft gold reflections, majestic and protective, premium depth without excessive fire.
Text (verbatim): "Dragon Hoard" exactly once, Dragon on first line and Hoard on second, very large clear bold fantasy serif display lettering with pale warm-gold faces, dark crimson shadow and restrained gold bevel.
Constraints: no other words, slogans, payout promises, reels, numbers, fake UI, spin buttons, brand logos or watermarks. No additional cultural/religious motifs, Chinese dragon styling, people, weapons, gore or extra creatures. Single original finished catalogue illustration.

No new objects, extra text, labels, UI, brands, payout claims or watermarks.
